tools.name: search-jobs-tool
tools.description: Semantic + structured search over Hosco hospitality jobs. Mirrors the smart filtering and ranking from hosco-v2: hard-excludes private/expired/inactive postings, supports visibility/promotion/external filters, configurable language matching (subset/any/all), and the v2 "suggested" ordering (relevance → Hosco-native → VIP → freshness). Returns ranked matches with relevance scores.

query.description: Natural-language search (e.g. "sommelier in Paris fine dining"). When provided, ranks by semantic similarity. When omitted, returns latest jobs filtered + sorted by the structured options.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. FR, GB, ES.

department.description: Hosco category code, e.g. f-b-kitchen, housekeeping, sommelier, reception.

content_language.description: Language code the job ad itself is written in (auto-detected), e.g. "en", "fr". Use this to only show postings the candidate can actually read — unrelated to the languages filter below.

contract_type.description: One of: internship (students only), professional (professionals only), open (both).

experience_years_max.description: Maximum years of experience the candidate has — only show jobs requiring less than or equal to this.

languages.description: Candidate language codes, e.g. ["en","fr"]. Matched against the job's mandatory fluency requirement ("Require fluency in" in hosco-v2), not the language the ad is written in. Combined with languages_mode.

languages_mode.description: How to interpret `languages`: "all" (job must require every code; default), "any" (job requires at least one of them), "subset" (job's required languages must all be in the provided list — i.e. the candidate speaks them all).

visibilities.description: Visibility tiers to include: public, targeted, lite, prime (private is never returned on this public surface).

promotion_types.description: Filter to specific promotion statuses: 0=disabled, 1=prime, 2=lite-basic, 4=lite-full. Status 3 (private) is always excluded.

only_external.description: Only return jobs sourced from external aggregators.

hide_external.description: Hide jobs sourced from external aggregators (Hosco-native only).

posted_after.description: ISO date; only return jobs published on or after this date.

sort.description: Ordering: "suggested" (default — relevance, then Hosco-native, then VIP, then freshness), "posted" (newest activation date), "update_date" (most recently updated), "title" (alphabetical).

tools.name: list-jobs-tool
tools.description: List the most recently published Hosco jobs, paginated. Use this when no semantic search is needed — for natural-language search, use the search jobs tool instead.

tools.name: job-details-tool
tools.description: Fetch the full details of a single Hosco job by its slug or numeric id. Use this after a search/list result to retrieve the full description, requirements, benefits, and all other available fields.

slug.description: The job slug (preferred lookup key — present in search/list results).

id.description: The numeric job id. Provide either slug or id.

tools.name: search-courses-tool
tools.description: Search Hosco's catalogue of hospitality courses and training programmes (bartending, culinary, hospitality management, languages, revenue management and more). Supports a free-text query plus filters for category, language, learning type and price. Hidden and deleted courses are never returned. Every result carries a canonical `url`.

query.description: Free-text search over course titles and descriptions, e.g. "cocktail", "revenue management", "sommelier".

categories.description: Course category codes, e.g. ["bartending"], ["culinary","pastry"]. Known codes: culinary, pastry, cruises, oenology, hospitality-management, sales-and-marketing, event-management, languages, revenue-management, reception, bartending, food-and-beverages, spa, tourism, business-skills.

languages.description: Language codes the course is taught in, e.g. ["en"], ["es","fr"].

min_price.description: Minimum price in the course's own currency. Use 0 with max_price 0 for free courses.

max_price.description: Maximum price in the course's own currency.

sort.description: Order by "price" or "duration". Omit for the catalogue's default relevance order.

locale.description: Language for the returned course links: en (default), es, fr or it. Match the language the member is writing in.

tools.name: course-details-tool
tools.description: Fetch the full details of a single Hosco course by its slug. Use this after a search result to retrieve the full description, programme details, provider, price, duration, delivery type and languages.

slug.description: The course slug, exactly as returned by the search tool.

locale.description: Language for the returned course link: en (default), es, fr or it.
